payload.rationale: This document is a July 2026 sprint retro that echoes the March 2026 Sprint 4 retro almost verbatim — same 23-point velocity claim, same Zephyr-as-key-unlock attribution, same async decision widget shipped. I expanded all three narratives (AntiSlackPositioning, DecisionsEvaporate, ZeroEffortCapture) because the widget, the velocity metric, and the Zephyr integration each sit under one or more of these, and the passes need them to bind rather than duplicate. I expanded every position under those narratives — ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Sprint4ThesisProven, WebhookArchitecture, PricingTwelveDollars, PricingTier25Plus, ContextPreservationNextSprint, AntiPatternRealtimeChat, ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, TargetMarketRemoteTeams — because this new retro could extend, contradict, or confirm any of them (especially ContextPreservationNextSprint, since the 'next sprint' it anticipated may now have occurred). I included the prior Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322, both observations (Obs_TinaVelocity, Obs_TanyaThesisProven), and both style observations (DirectQuote, MetricAnchor) so the passes can recognize the same claims and register style without minting new positions. No areas were deliberately excluded — the document is short but sits at the intersection of the product's entire positioning, architecture, and pricing thread.
